intro_1: The system is designed to manage the process of powerlifting competitions in online mode, simulating the operation of a local network.
intro_2: It allows multiple devices to work simultaneously and display live competition results in real time.
scenariosTitle: The system supports the following usage scenarios:
admin_text_1: The main device used to manage data and control the operation of all clients.
admin_text_2: It allows athlete registration, session and flight management, entering and displaying live changes, as well as pre- and post-competition documentation.
clientsIntro: The system supports an arbitrary number of client devices, which can operate according to the following scenarios:
CLIENT_1_TEXT: Displays current competition protocols, results, and result predictions for the current session or weight category.
CLIENT_2_TEXT: Displays the order of athlete attempts based on declared weight, draw results, and other rules.
CLIENT_3_TEXT: Shows the plate loading sequence for the athlete on the platform and the next athlete.
CLIENT_4_TEXT: An information display for spectators showing details about the athlete currently on the platform.
CLIENT_5_TEXT: Controls attempt time, countdowns, and time until the start of competition.
CLIENT_6_TEXT: A separate client for judges responsible for athlete weigh-ins.
footer: All weigh-in data is transferred directly into the system without the need to enter it manually through the main Admin device.
